Name: BeCSBelraiScore
Title: BelRAI Score Code System
Description: Codes identifying each BelRAI scoring scale/screener, used as Observation.code.

Name: BeCSReferenceRangeType
Title: Reference Range Type
Description: The meaning of an Observation.referenceRange for a score: a band defined by the scale, or the band the result falls into. Deliberately valence-free (no 'normal'/'high'/'elevated').

Name: BeCSScore
Title: Score Code System
Description: Codes as defined initially by the NIHDI. Dutch translations were not yet defined but are planned   for a next release.
